profile.headline: Software Engineer for Microsoft
profile.summary:
My name is Jaren, and I am a graduate from Northeastern University’s Computer Science program. I concentrated in software engineering, focusing on how to develop meaningful systems from material to user. I enjoy good writing, good code design, and good music.

Currently working on Outlook Mobile iOS at Microsoft Corp. 

interests: art & menswear, drums, full-stack architecture, government & politics, material design, & physics

I cannot know what the future will bring
But regardless of chosen profession,
Consider giving some of your life
To the field of politics

positions.title: Lead
positions.description:
Project BCAN (Boston Climate Action Network) =]
* Workshop hosting and software architecture
* Deployed a full stack grant management tool to help the organization manage grant applications and their respective details!
* Participant in a leadership series dedicated to re-inventing the club to better focus on career development, create connectedness of members, and establish an understanding of societal problems; primarily looking at how to provide support in the non profit organization space.
positions.insights: Engineering Leadership, Software Architecture and +3 skills

honors.title: Magna Cum Laude
honors.issuer: Issued by Northeastern University, Boston Campus · May 2025

honors.title: HackBoston Top 2 Track Finalist
honors.description:
36 hour event co-hosted by the Harvard Blockchain Club and MIT Bitcoin Club. Other universities in attendance included: MIT, Princeton, Yale, Brown, BU, Northeastern, Columbia, and Cornell. $110,000 USD in total prizes was available.

I was responsible for frontend development. Our team developed crowdfunding whitelist software using blockchain principles for more automated, secure, and transparent payments.
honors.issuer: Issued by EasyA x Reach · Sep 2022
